description: Weekend getaway planner: weather and local leads for a 2-3 day trip to a destination. Pass destination (place name) or lat and lon; optional origin, start_date, end_date, transportation_modes and budget. Returns JSON with the forecast for the start date, breweries and places near the destination, and weekend_shape and lodging_posture, which are general template guidance and labelled so. No booking inventory or prices. $0.25 via x402; not charged when the place cannot be located or no data comes back. This MCP never pays: it returns the live result if the backend answers, or the request URL and x402 payment metadata for a client that can pay.
name: plan_weekend_getaway
